card.name: Digits in phone numbers and street addresses
card.fires_on: A single digit, usually 0 or 5, inside a phone area code or a street number. It appears in contact details such as 800 toll-free numbers or FDA and organization addresses.

modes.label: Toll-free area code
modes.description: The 0 or 5 inside an 800 or 855 number in a call-for-information line.

modes.label: Street number
modes.description: A digit inside a street number in a mailing address.
